HMO Conversion

Nine-bedroom HMO conversion, Hampstead NW3

Hampstead, London NW32023 to 202416 photos

Victorian property on Finchley Road, Hampstead, converted into a high-specification nine-bedroom HMO, combining original character with modern living standards. Each bedroom is designed as a private suite, featuring an en-suite bathroom and a compact kitchenette, providing both independence and comfort. Two communal kitchens, located on the ground and top floors, offer additional shared space for residents. The layout has been carefully planned to maximise space, functionality, and compliance with all current HMO and building regulations, resulting in a well-balanced and efficient multi-occupancy residence in a prime Hampstead location. Building control final certificate issued August 2024.
